lines.en: label dormwartwo19:
scene endofsecondwar1
$ totaldays += 1
$ day -= 6
show monday
And so it all comes to an end once more.
lines.zh: 于是，这一切又一次迎来了结束。

lines.en: The girls, with one notable maritime exception, have shed their appropriated (And often times {i}inappropriate{/i}) skin in order to return to their normal forms.
lines.zh: 女孩们——除了一个显而易见的海洋生物例外——都褪下了她们借来的（而且经常是{i}不太得体{/i}的）外皮，恢复成平时的模样。

lines.en: And after two full days of seeing them in costumes, it comes as a relief in saying-
lines.zh: 在看了整整两天她们穿着戏服的样子后，说句实话本来是挺让人松一口气的——

lines.en: Actually, no. I still wish they were in their costumes.
lines.zh: 不，其实我倒希望她们还穿着戏服。

lines.en: But I’m glad this is all wrapping and that I likely won’t have to deal with this much excitement again for a full year.
lines.zh: 不过我很高兴这一切终于收尾，接下来整整一年大概都不用再应付这种程度的刺激了。

lines.en: Or at least however long it takes for Kumon-mi’s malformed timeline to reach my fourth Halloween. Which could honestly be like, three weeks at this point. But who knows?
lines.zh: 或者至少，要等到 Kumon-mi 那条畸形时间线走到我的第四个万圣节为止。老实说按现在的进度，大概也就三周吧。谁知道呢？

lines.en: Either way, play time is over. Which means it’s time to get serious and pass out results.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，玩乐的时间结束了。也就是说，该认真起来公布结果了。

lines.en: And also find out what everyone gets to do with me as the reward this time, which I don’t think has been confirmed as of yet.
lines.zh: 顺便也该弄清楚这次的奖品——也就是她们能拿我干什么——到底是什么，我觉得这一点到现在都还没定下来。

lines.en: : Let’s do this.
lines.zh: : 开始吧。

lines.en: : Somebody’s really raring to go this morning, huh?
lines.zh: : 今天早上有人可是干劲十足啊，嗯？

lines.en: : There’s no time to be gentle when the lives of ten girls are at stake.
lines.zh: : 十个女孩的性命危在旦夕，可没工夫温柔了。

lines.en: : I want to say that no one is taking this contest that seriously but, unfortunately (And rather depressingly) I think you might be right.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说没人会把这种比赛当真，但很不幸（而且相当让人沮丧），我觉得你可能是对的。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar2
: Alright! Listen up, everybody! In just a few minutes, we’ll be going over the final results for this year’s Super Mega Ultimate Dorm War (Halloween Version)!
lines.zh: : 好了！大家听好了！再过几分钟，我们就要公布今年「超级无敌终极宿舍大战（万圣节版）」的最终结果了！

lines.en: : But before we do that, we have one {i}other{/i} batch of votes we need to go over. And, as I’m sure you already know, those votes are for this year’s popularity contest.
lines.zh: : 但在那之前，还有{i}另一{/i}批投票要先处理。我想你们也都已经知道了——那就是今年的人气投票。

lines.en: : So if Chika and Otoha could-
lines.zh: : 那么请 Chika 和 Otoha 到前——

lines.en: : Wait, where’s Otoha? I don’t see her out there.
lines.zh: : 等等，Otoha 呢？我没在那边看到她。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar3
: She didn’t want to come.
lines.zh: : 她不想来。

lines.en: : Seriously? Is she still mad about last night?
lines.zh: : 真的假的？她还在为昨晚的事生气？

lines.en: : Probably. All I asked was if she was coming or not. We haven’t really {i}talked{/i} yet.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。我也就问了她来不来。我们还没怎么{i}说过话{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, I guess that makes things easier to announce then since voting was a total blowout in Chika’s favor.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那宣布起来反倒省事了——毕竟投票结果是一边倒地偏向 Chika。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar4
: Heh. Of course it was.
lines.zh: : 哼。那当然了。

lines.en: : Yup! As it turns out, not showing up to events or campaigning to get votes doesn’t do much to bolster your chances of victory! So...congratulations, Chika! And great job at...being places!
lines.zh: : 没错！事实证明，既不参加活动也不拉票，对提高胜算可没什么帮助！所以……恭喜你，Chika！还有，干得漂亮——你很擅长……出现在现场！

lines.en: $ dorm1war2points += 1
: Thank you, Imani. And thank you to everyone who voted for me. I happily accept both my second consecutive Dorm War victory {i}and{/i} my role as the most popular girl in school.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Imani。也谢谢所有投给我的人。我很乐意接受这连续第二次的宿舍大战胜利，{i}以及{/i}全校最受欢迎女生这个头衔。

lines.en: : Did you see the full results? Our class was obviously split, but you blew it out of the water with the rest of the school.
lines.zh: : 你看到完整结果了吗？我们班显然是分裂的，但在全校那边你可是碾压式的。

lines.en: : Yeah. And I’m sure that has {i}nothing{/i} to do with the fact that Otoha transferred in late and doesn’t know as many people.
lines.zh: : 是啊。而且我敢说这跟 Otoha 转学来得太晚、认识的人不多{i}毫无{/i}关系。

lines.en: : It really comes down to just knowing how to talk to the voters. And if there is anything I’m good at, it’s-
lines.zh: : 归根结底就是懂怎么跟选民打交道。而我最擅长的就是——

lines.en: : Manipulation? Bribery? Blackmail?
lines.zh: : 操纵？贿赂？勒索？

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar5
: Being {i}social.{/i}
: {i}Blech.{/i} Even worse.
lines.zh: : {i}呕{/i}。那更糟。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar6
: Okay! So now that our final contest is all wrapped up...who’s ready to hear the results?!
lines.zh: : 好了！既然最后一项比赛也全部结束了……谁准备好听结果了？！

lines.en: A small round of applause rings out and attracts a few passersby to stop and observe what’s going on, only to find a crowd of teenagers, a girl in a dolphin suit, and a “foreigner” reading something off of a tablet.
lines.zh: 一阵稀稀拉拉的掌声响起，引得几个路人驻足观望发生了什么——结果只看到一群青少年、一个穿着海豚玩偶服的女孩，还有一个正照着平板电脑念东西的「外国人」。

lines.en: Needless to say, the applause does not hold their attention for long. Which is good because I highly doubt they’d understand what’s happening here anyway.
lines.zh: 不用说，这掌声并没能留住他们多久。这样也好，反正我很怀疑他们根本搞不清这里在干什么。

lines.en: if harukalust25 == True or kirinlust30 == True:
: Oh, but we {i}do{/i} have some bonus points we need to factor in first, just so we’re all on the same page.
lines.zh: : 哦，不过我们{i}还有{/i}一些加分要先算进去，好让大家心里有数。

lines.en: if harukalust25 == True:
scene endofsecondwar7
: Concerning that matter of Sara Sakakibara representing her daughter and Haruka Hamasaki representing Molly...
lines.zh: : 关于 Sara Sakakibara 代表她女儿、Haruka Hamasaki 代表 Molly 出战一事……

lines.en: : This is not a matter I had any prior knowledge of.
lines.zh: : 这件事我事先并不知情。

lines.en: : Did they...have some kind of rematch behind our back?...
lines.zh: : 她们……背着我们私下又比了一场？……

lines.en: : Either that or Sir has been hosting some rather unsavory “bonus contests” on GM Island in exchange for additional points. Which of course sounds utterly ridiculous to-
lines.zh: : 要么就是老师在 GM 岛上举办了些相当不堪的「加分赛」，以此换取额外分数。当然，这听起来荒唐透顶，简直——

lines.en: : Please...stop talking...
lines.zh: : 求你……别说了……

lines.en: : Yeah, I was just about to.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也正打算闭嘴。

lines.en: if harukabjwin == True:
: One bonus point has been awarded to the second floor!
lines.zh: : 二楼获得一分加分！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar8
: Mwahahaha...it appears my power is so great that even the Magistrate of Mammaries was able to win on my behalf.
lines.zh: : 哇哈哈哈……看来我的力量如此强大，连「胸部法官」都能替我赢下一局。

lines.en: : And...I guess my mom is just as useless as I am...
lines.zh: : 而且……看来我妈跟我一样没用……

lines.en: else:
: One bonus point has been awarded to the first floor!
lines.zh: : 一楼获得一分加分！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar9
: Tch!
: My mom...redeemed me...
lines.zh: : 我妈……救赎了我……

lines.en: : But at what cost, Zagull? {i}At what cost?{/i}
lines.zh: : 但代价是什么呢，Zagull？{i}代价是什么？{/i}

lines.en: : I don’t...want to think about that...
lines.zh: : 我……不想去想那个……

lines.en: if kirinlust30 == True:
scene endofsecondwar10
: Concerning the matter of Miku Maruyama vs Kirin Kanda...
lines.zh: : 关于 Miku Maruyama 对 Kirin Kanda 一事……

lines.en: : The what now?
lines.zh: : 什么玩意儿？

lines.en: : It appears that you and Kirin may have taken it into your hands to act outside the jurisdiction of official Dorm War regulations.
lines.zh: : 看来你和 Kirin 可能自作主张，进行了超出宿舍大战正式规则管辖范围的行动。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. But what’s that mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。可那是什么意思？

lines.en: : It means you two had some sort of rogue contest without telling anyone about it. Likely after you left with Kirin last night.
lines.zh: : 意思是你们俩搞了某种没告诉任何人的私下比赛。很可能就是昨晚你跟 Kirin 走之后。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar11
: That true? What’d we even do?
lines.zh: : 真的假的？我们到底干了啥？

lines.en: : We played Monopoly.
lines.zh: : 我们玩了大富翁。

lines.en: : But I ain’t ever even played Monopoly before.
lines.zh: : 可我压根儿从没玩过大富翁啊。

lines.en: if mikuwarhjwin == True:
: One bonus point has been awarded to the first floor!
lines.zh: : 一楼获得一分加分！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar12
: How the heck did I manage to win a game I ain’t ever played?! Am I actually kind of amazing?!
lines.zh: : 我到底是怎么赢了一个我从没玩过的游戏啊？！我是不是其实挺厉害的？！

lines.en: : I kept getting distracted.
lines.zh: : 我一直分心。

lines.en: : That’s all it was.
lines.zh: : 就只是这样。

lines.en: else:
: One point has been awarded to the second floor!
lines.zh: : 二楼获得一分加分！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar12
: That ain’t fair! I got talked into playin’ a game I didn’t know how to play! And I don’t even remember any bonus contests!
lines.zh: : 这不公平！我被人哄着玩了一个我不会玩的游戏！而且我压根不记得有什么加分赛！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar13
: How did you even find out about the bonus points anyway?
lines.zh: : 话说你到底是怎么知道这些加分的？

lines.en: : Through the app, of course. There’s a special submission page for “Anonymous bonus contests.”
lines.zh: : 当然是通过应用啊。有个专门用来提交「匿名加分赛」的页面。

lines.en: : They’re not anonymous anymore once you start providing names and announcing victors.
lines.zh: : 一旦你开始说出名字并宣布获胜者，它们就不匿名了。

lines.en: : Shh. It’s my first time doing this. You have to be gentle with me.
lines.zh: : 嘘。我可是第一次干这个。你得对我温柔点。

lines.en: : Just read the rest of the results, Imani.
lines.zh: : 把剩下的结果念完就行，Imani。

lines.en: : Fine, fine.
lines.zh: : 好好好。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar14
: The winner...
lines.zh: : 获胜者是……

lines.en: : Of this year’s Super Mega Ultimate Dorm War...
lines.zh: : 今年超级无敌终极宿舍大战的获胜者是……

lines.en: if dorm1war2points > dorm2war2points:
$ dormwar2floor1win = True
scene endofsecondwar15
: Is the first floor with a final score of [dorm1war2points] to [dorm2war2points]! Congratulations, guys!
lines.zh: : 一楼！最终比分 [dorm1war2points] 比 [dorm2war2points]！恭喜你们！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar20
: I’d like to thank myself. Ayane. Maya. Dorm 1. Sana. Miku. Dorm 4. And myself again.
lines.zh: : 我要感谢我自己。Ayane。Maya。一号楼。Sana。Miku。四号楼。还有我自己，再说一遍。

lines.en: : I take it that means the truce between you and Makoto has ended?
lines.zh: : 看来你和 Makoto 之间的休战结束了？

lines.en: : That depends entirely on how much she clings to my uncle when we redeem our prize.
lines.zh: : 那完全取决于我们兑换奖品时，她会往我叔叔身上贴多紧。

lines.en: : And exactly what was that prize again? Because last year, it was keeping Sensei in our room for the beach trip. And this year it’s just {i}Sensei.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那奖品到底是什么来着？去年是把老师留在我们房间里陪我们去海滩旅行。今年就只是{i}「老师」{/i}。

lines.en: : That’s it. That’s all anyone ever said.
lines.zh: : 就这样。大家说的就只有这些。

lines.en: : Guess that means he’s ours forever then!
lines.zh: : 那也就是说他永远归我们了！

lines.en: : Trust me when I say this, but that’s the single worst thing you could ever wish for.
lines.zh: : 相信我，这可是你能许下的最糟糕的愿望。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s that bad.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没那么糟。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar21
: There are always debates about whether eternal life would be good or bad and...I can kind of see both sides in those.
lines.zh: : 关于永生到底是好是坏，一直都有争论……而我两边都能理解一点。

lines.en: : But spending an eternity with the person you love isn’t ever {i}bad.{/i} It can just...have bad parts? Or something?
lines.zh: : 但和你爱的人共度永恒从来都不算{i}坏事{/i}。只是……可能会有些糟糕的部分？大概吧？

lines.en: : The way you say that makes it sound like you actually {i}are{/i} immortal.
lines.zh: : 你这说法听起来，好像你{i}真的{/i}是不死之身似的。

lines.en: : Yeah...that would be great, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊……那该多好啊，不是吗？

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar22
: Does winning make you feel any better, Rin? I know Otoha isn’t here to celebrate or anything, but-
lines.zh: : 赢了会让你好受点吗，Rin？我知道 Otoha 不在这儿、没法一起庆祝什么的，不过——

lines.en: : She wouldn’t {i}celebrate{/i} in the first place. She’d just be like “Rin, why are you so excited to win some middle aged dude who probably just wants to fuck you?”
lines.zh: : 她本来也不会{i}庆祝{/i}。她只会说「Rin，你为什么会为了赢一个大概只想操你的中年男人这么兴奋？」

lines.en: : Sounds exciting to me.
lines.zh: : 我听着倒挺刺激的。

lines.en: : It’s probably just hard for her to understand there’s more to your relationship than that. From an outside perspective...I’m sure a lot of people would think that about you and Sensei.
lines.zh: : 对她来说，大概只是很难理解你们的关系不止于此。从外人的角度看……肯定有很多人会这么想你和老师。

lines.en: : Well, a lot of people would be wrong. Things are more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那很多人都错了。事情比那要复杂得多。

lines.en: : Are you implying Sensei {i}doesn’t{/i} want to fuck you?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示老师{i}不想{/i}操你吗？

lines.en: : I mean...no. He probably does. But that’s not {i}why{/i} we’re close. Or...{i}were{/i} close. I’ve thought about having sex with all of my friends before but that doesn’t mean that’s the only reason I keep them around.
lines.zh: : 我是说……不是。他大概确实想。但那不是我们亲近的{i}原因{/i}。或者说……{i}曾经{/i}亲近的原因。我以前也幻想过跟所有朋友上床，可那不代表这是我把她们留在身边的唯一理由。

lines.en: : {i}All{/i} of your friends?
lines.zh: : {i}所有{/i}朋友？

lines.en: : Futaba, do you have any idea how dramatically different my life would be if you liked girls?
lines.zh: : Futaba，你知不知道如果你喜欢女生，我的人生会有多大的不同？

lines.en: : I...try not to think about that.
lines.zh: : 我……尽量不去想那个。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} like girls. And boys. And women. And men. And pretty much anything else that can be used in a sexual manner. Which includes your mother- who is currently my new fascination.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}喜欢女生。也喜欢男生。还有女人。还有男人。以及几乎任何能以性方式使用的东西。其中包括你妈——她现在是我新的迷恋对象。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I should be more offended that you want to bang my mom or that you put her after “anything that can be used in a sexual manner.”
lines.zh: : 我不知道我该更生气于你想睡我妈，还是你把她排在「任何能以性方式使用的东西」后面。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m sure I could find plenty of uses for her.
lines.zh: : 哦，我肯定能给她找到大把用途。

lines.en: : Don’t bang my mom, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 别睡我妈，Nodoka。

lines.en: : I do what I please.
lines.zh: : 我爱干嘛干嘛。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar23
: Congratulations, guys. It was a hard fought battle and I think I speak for all of us on the second floor when I say...
lines.zh: : 恭喜你们。这是一场苦战，我想我可以代表二楼所有人说……

lines.en: : I am extremely jealous and hope these results are overridden by some supernatural force that compels Sensei to come to us instead of you. Also, grr.
lines.zh: : 我非常嫉妒，希望有某种超自然力量推翻这个结果，迫使老师到我们这边来而不是你们那边。另外，呜。

lines.en: : It’s only natural that we won. Your floor is far too spontaneous and disorganized to truly compete for Sensei’s heart as a group.
lines.zh: : 我们赢是理所当然的。你们楼层太随性、太没组织，根本没法作为一个团体去争夺老师的心。

lines.en: : You’re like a bunch of solo entities just floating around and trying to take him for yourselves.
lines.zh: : 你们就像一堆各自漂浮的独立个体，个个都想把他据为己有。

lines.en: : That makes it sound like the first floor is aiming for one giant, loving orgy.
lines.zh: : 这听起来像是一楼的目标是一场巨大的、充满爱的群交。

lines.en: : Well, I can’t speak for Makoto, but-
lines.zh: : 嗯，Makoto 的我不好说，不过——

lines.en: : Miku, this is one of those times you probably shouldn’t speak at all.
lines.zh: : Miku，这种时候你最好一个字都别说。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m just sayin’ that I wouldn’t mind if Sensei wanted to date all of us so long as we put some kinda schedule together.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我只是说如果老师想跟我们所有人交往，只要排个时间表，我是不介意的。

lines.en: : Yes, and that’s exactly what I wanted you to avoid saying.
lines.zh: : 对，我让你别说的正是这个。

lines.en: : The fact of the matter is, and I’m sure I can speak for {i}all{/i} of the first floor when I say this, but...
lines.zh: : 事实是这样的，而且我确信我可以代表一楼{i}全体{/i}说这句话，不过……

lines.en: : Nana-nana-poo-poo. Sensei loves us more than you.
lines.zh: : 略略略。老师爱我们比爱你们多。

lines.en: : Get wrecked, losers.
lines.zh: : 输爆吧，废物们。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar24
: That’s my Makoto. Only toxic when it counts.
lines.zh: : 这才是我的 Makoto。只在关键时候才毒。

lines.en: : Happy to have ya back.
lines.zh: : 很高兴你回来了。

lines.en: : Wish I could say the same...
lines.zh: : 真希望我也能这么说……

lines.en: if dorm2war2points > dorm1war2points:
$ dormwar2floor2win = True
scene endofsecondwar15
: Is the second floor with a final score of [dorm2war2points] to [dorm1war2points]! Congratulations, guys!
lines.zh: : 二楼！最终比分 [dorm2war2points] 比 [dorm1war2points]！恭喜你们！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar25
: Sorry for your loss, Miku.
lines.zh: : 节哀，Miku。

lines.en: : Yeah and {i}I’m{/i} sorry you’re such a butt.
lines.zh: : 行啊，{i}我{/i}也很遗憾你这么讨厌。

lines.en: : We did it! The second floor prevails!
lines.zh: : 我们做到了！二楼获胜！

lines.en: : But...what exactly is our prize again? Because last year it was the whole rooming thing but this year all I ever heard anyone say was “Sensei.”
lines.zh: : 不过……我们的奖品到底是什么来着？去年是那一整套住宿安排，可今年我听到的所有说法就只有「老师」。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar26
: It’s more than enough! I just want to know what I am and {i}am not{/i} allowed to do and whether or not the rest of you have to be involved or if I can just run away with him.
lines.zh: : 这已经够多了！我只想知道我能做什么、{i}不能{/i}做什么，以及你们其他人是不是非得参与，还是说我可以干脆带他私奔。

lines.en: : I’m fine with you running away so long as you film your first time and send it to me. That’s a thing friends do, right?
lines.zh: : 你要私奔我没意见，只要你把第一次录下来发给我。朋友之间就是这么干的，对吧？

lines.en: : Okay, but you’re not allowed to make fun of me if I cry.
lines.zh: : 行，但要是我哭了，你不许笑话我。

lines.en: : You two are kind of disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你们两个有点恶心。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar27
: What’s so disgusting about friendship? Are you telling me you wouldn’t let Miku watch your sex tape? Not even for moral support or constructive criticism?
lines.zh: : 友谊有什么恶心的？你是说你不会让 Miku 看你的性爱录像？哪怕是为了精神支持，或者建设性意见？

lines.en: : If anybody’s gonna be givin’ Makoto constructive criticism on the art of knockin’ boots, it’s gonna be her mom. She knows her way around those kinda tapes.
lines.zh: : 要说谁该在「床上功夫」这门艺术上给 Makoto 提建设性意见，那肯定是她妈。她对那种录像可熟门熟路了。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar28
: I’m going to the convenience store. Does anyone want anything?
lines.zh: : 我要去便利店。有人要带什么吗？

lines.en: : Makoto, wait! My phone’s in your pocket!
lines.zh: : Makoto，等等！我手机在你口袋里！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar29
: Alas, it appears the raid boss known as floor one has been taken down after a mere two days worth of progression. And the loot drop? A large, handsome Japanese man.
lines.zh: : 唉，看来名为「一楼」的团队副本首领，仅仅经过两天的攻略就被打倒了。而战利品掉落呢？一个高大英俊的日本男人。

lines.en: : But who will it be that gets to equip him? Will such armor fit in- err...{i}on{/i} any one of us?
lines.zh: : 但究竟由谁来装备他呢？这样一副铠甲能套进——呃……套在我们中任何一个人{i}身上{/i}吗？

lines.en: : If size is the important factor, I believe I am the one most suited for this job.
lines.zh: : 如果尺寸是关键因素的话，我相信我是最适合这份工作的人。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar30
: I’m not even sure if you know what the job entails.
lines.zh: : 我都不确定你到底知不知道这份工作是干什么的。

lines.en: : If this is about Virginia, I have been studying so as to not make myself look like a fool.
lines.zh: : 如果是指弗吉尼亚州的事，我一直在学习，免得自己出洋相。

lines.en: : And with a population of 8.642 million and 44 inches of average annual rainfall, it is safe to say that I know everything there is to know.
lines.zh: : 人口 864.2 万，年平均降雨量 44 英寸，可以稳妥地说，该知道的我都知道了。

lines.en: : Yup. You’ve got it, Kendo Princess. You’re ready to become a woman now.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你懂了，剑道公主。你现在已经准备好成为一个女人了。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar31
: If only my father were here and healthy enough to hear that.
lines.zh: : 要是我父亲还在、身体还硬朗到能听到这句话就好了。

lines.en: : Um...congratulations on...winning the Dorm War...
lines.zh: : 呃……恭喜……赢了宿舍大战……

lines.en: : No grats needed, Zagull. Tis’ but the fruits of our hard labor ripening and being knocked from the trees like Sunsettias.
lines.zh: : 不用道贺，Zagull。这不过是咱们辛勤劳作的果实成熟了，像日落果一样被人从树上打下来罢了。

lines.en: : But while the next chapter in the story of the second floor is still a work in progress, we should go back to that arcade and conquer the escape game once and for all.
lines.zh: : 不过二楼故事的新篇章还在撰写之中，我们应该回那家电玩城，把那个密室逃脱游戏彻底通关。

lines.en: : Unless being in the light music club means that you’re also too much of a normie to spend time with me now.
lines.zh: : 除非加入了轻音部，就意味着你现在也变成了一个太正常的普通人，没空陪我了。

lines.en: : It...doesn’t...
: I’d...I’d be happy to go...
lines.zh: : 我……我很愿意去……

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar32
: Touka, Touka...All of the girls on our floor look very happy. Is it because Sensei is now our prisoner?
lines.zh: : Touka，Touka……我们楼层所有女孩看起来都很开心。是因为老师现在成了我们的俘虏吗？

lines.en: : Something like that, Yasu. I believe the details are a bit hazy at the moment, though. But, that said, we couldn’t have done it without you.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，Yasu。不过我觉得具体细节目前还有点模糊。但话说回来，没有你可办不成。

lines.en: : Yes you could have. There is nothing special about my existence- only what goes {i}through{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 不，你们照样能做到。我的存在本身毫无特别之处——特别的是{i}经由{/i}我而过的东西。

lines.en: : But the fact that those things go through you at all makes you special, does it not?
lines.zh: : 可那些东西偏偏会经由你而来，这本身就让你很特别，不是吗？

lines.en: : Regardless of what you believe or what anyone may say about you, you’re an essential member of our floor and things would surely fall apart without you.
lines.zh: : 无论你怎么想、无论别人怎么说你，你都是我们楼层不可或缺的一员，没有你一切肯定会崩塌。

lines.en: : Things will fall apart regardless of whether or not I am there to take up space. It is the way the world must move.
lines.zh: : 不管我在不在那里占位置，事情都会崩塌。世界本就该这样运转。

lines.en: : Destroy. Rebuild. And when rebuilding is impossible, create something new. It is this cycle that permeates our daily lives. Drips out of our faucets and-
lines.zh: : 毁灭。重建。而当重建不可能时，就创造新的东西。正是这种循环渗透在我们的日常生活里。从我们的水龙头里滴落，然后——

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar33
: Boop.
: Eep!
if dorm1war2points == dorm2war2points:
$ dormwar2tie = True
scene endofsecondwar15
: Is no one!
lines.zh: : 谁都不是！

lines.en: : Hah...
: No one wins! It was a tie!
lines.zh: : 没人获胜！是平局！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar16
: Oh well. I suppose Sensei will have to sleep alone for our next beach trip. What a shame.
lines.zh: : 哦好吧。看来下次海滩旅行老师只能一个人睡了。真遗憾啊。

lines.en: : The winner in the event of a tie should be the first floor! We’ve known him longer and like him more, so obviously we deserve to win!
lines.zh: : 平局的话获胜者应该是一楼！我们认识他更久，也更喜欢他，所以显然该我们赢！

lines.en: : Big disagree! Providing a numerical value to express our love for Sensei is inherently flawed due to people having different opinions on what “love” is...but I can guarantee you I sit alone at the top!
lines.zh: : 强烈反对！用数值来表达我们对老师的爱，本身就站不住脚，因为每个人对「爱」是什么见解不同……但我可以向你保证，我一个人高居榜首！

lines.en: : Which means it shall be me, Noriko, who gets to sit on his face. Thank you for coming to my TED Talk.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，能坐在他脸上的将会是我——Noriko。感谢各位来听我的 TED 演讲。

lines.en: : If anyone is sitting on Sensei’s face, its going to be-
lines.zh: : 如果是有人要坐在老师脸上，那也应该是——

lines.en: : {i}Psst. Bad idea.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘘。这主意不妙。{/i}

lines.en: : ...not me because I am his niece!
lines.zh: : ……不是我，因为我是他侄女！

lines.en: : But anyone who so much as tries to needs to take it up with me first so I can say no!
lines.zh: : 但任何想这么做的人都得先过我这关，好让我说不！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar17
: Touka, can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : Touka，我能问你件事吗？

lines.en: : Always, Yasu. What is it?
lines.zh: : 随时都行，Yasu。什么事？

lines.en: : Why do people want to sit on our teacher’s face?
lines.zh: : 为什么大家都想坐在我们老师脸上？

lines.en: : Chairs are not just the instrument we use to sit, but they also rid us of our senses and bring us closer to God in the process.
lines.zh: : 椅子不只是我们用来坐的器具，它还会让我们失去感官，并在这个过程中让我们更接近上帝。

lines.en: : If that is what you believe...that’s...{i}nice.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果这是你的信仰……那……{i}挺好的{/i}。

lines.en: : But why a human? There are so many other things we can do with humans. Why would you sit on one?
lines.zh: : 可为什么是个人呢？人类可以做的事有那么多。为什么要坐在一个人身上？

lines.en: : I don’t really-
lines.zh: : 我也不太——

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar18
: Wait! I understand!
lines.zh: : 等等！我明白了！

lines.en: : I highly doubt that, but please. Proceed.
lines.zh: : 我非常怀疑，不过请讲。

lines.en: : An alternative to duct tape!
lines.zh: : 是胶带的替代品！

lines.en: : Mhm.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : A blindfold of flesh for when the adhesive will not adhere! A means of blinding someone who refuses to blind themself! A means of forcing that person closer to God!
lines.zh: : 一剂血肉做的眼罩，用在胶带粘不住的时候！一种让拒绝蒙住双眼的人被迫失明的手段！一种强迫那个人更接近上帝的手段！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar19
: Which means...
lines.zh: : 也就是说……

lines.en: : Please don’t, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 别啊，Yasu。

lines.en: : {i}I must sit on his face as well...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也必须坐在他脸上……{/i}

lines.en: scene black
scene endofsecondwar34
: Well...it’s all over. The best holiday of the year has finally come to an end.
lines.zh: : 嗯……一切都结束了。一年里最棒的节日终于落幕了。

lines.en: : Memories were made...lives were destroyed...
lines.zh: : 留下了回忆……也毁掉了人生……

lines.en: : But most importantly...we got to see Io in a butler outfit.
lines.zh: : 但最重要的是……我们看到了 Io 穿管家装。

lines.en: : Was that seriously the best part of the weekend for you? Because that was probably in my bottom ten.
lines.zh: : 说真的，那是你这个周末最棒的部分？因为那大概排在我最糟的十件事里。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you stuck around long enough to make any sort of ranking. I feel like we barely saw you at the last Dorm War.
lines.zh: : 我挺惊讶你居然待得够久，还能排个名次。感觉上次宿舍大战我们几乎没见到你。

lines.en: : Probably because I find everyone but Uta, Sensei, and sometimes Otoha entirely unbearable.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为除了 Uta、老师，还有偶尔的 Otoha，我觉得其他人都完全让人受不了。

lines.en: : I take it you didn’t vote for me, then?
lines.zh: : 看来你没投给我咯？

lines.en: : I would have voted for a literal dog over you.
lines.zh: : 我宁可投给一条真正的狗，也不投给你。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar35
: I’m glad I didn’t have to run against a dog. I might be popular, but I’m not “beat a dog in a popularity contest” popular.
lines.zh: : 我很庆幸我不用跟狗竞争。我也许受欢迎，但还没受欢迎到「在人气比赛里赢过一条狗」的程度。

lines.en: : If we do this contest again next year...maybe you should run, Io?
lines.zh: : 如果明年还办这个比赛……也许你该参选，Io？

lines.en: : Run {i}away?{/i} Sure. I can do that.
lines.zh: : {i}逃跑？{/i}行啊。这个我擅长。

lines.en: : Run in the contest, obviously. Might be good to show people you’re not just a big ole antisocial jerk.
lines.zh: : 是参加比赛啦，当然是。也好让大家看看你不只是个彻头彻尾的反社会混蛋。

lines.en: : But...But that’s exactly who I am.
lines.zh: : 可……可我本来就是那样的人啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’re also really good at faking stuff when you really want to.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但你真的很擅长在想装的时候装得像模像样。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, I don’t hate you or anything. But I probably wouldn’t vote for you either because of the whole second floor thing.
lines.zh: : 稍微安慰你一下，我倒不讨厌你什么的。但我也大概不会投给你，因为二楼那档事。

lines.en: : Wait, why are you even here? Since when do you hang out with us?
lines.zh: : 等等，你为什么会在这儿？你从什么时候开始跟我们混了？

lines.en: : Rin is mad at me and Yumi is MIA. I gravitated toward Uta since she talks a lot.
lines.zh: : Rin 在生我的气，Yumi 又失踪了。我就自然被 Uta 吸引过去了，因为她话多。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, can you gravitate away now?
lines.zh: : 哦。那你现在能飘走吗？

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar36
: Nah. Not unless Yumi randomly shows up.
lines.zh: : 不。除非 Yumi 突然冒出来。

lines.en: : I’m Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我就是 Yumi。

lines.en: : Wow. Talk about convenient timing.
lines.zh: : 哇。这时间可真巧。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar37
: Yumi?! What are you doing here?!
lines.zh: : Yumi？！你在这儿干什么？！

lines.en: : Have somethin’ to take care of.
lines.zh: : 有点事要处理。

lines.en: : Nodoka, run!
lines.zh: : Nodoka，快跑！

lines.en: : Not that.
lines.zh: : 不是那个。

lines.en: : What do you have to take care of? Because I’m being kicked out of this group and I don’t want to walk around in circles pretending I’m on the phone.
lines.zh: : 你要处理什么？因为我正被这帮人往外赶，我可不想绕着圈子走来走去假装在打电话。

lines.en: : Just gotta have a quick conversation. Five minutes tops. Then we can go get breakfast or some shit. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 就是得聊两句。最多五分钟。然后我们去吃早餐什么的。我也不知道。

lines.en: : Wait, don’t you have school today? The fuck you guys doing just hanging out like this?
lines.zh: : 等等，你们今天不用上学吗？你们他妈的在这儿晃悠什么呢？

lines.en: : Since when does skipping matter to you?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候开始在意翘课了？

lines.en: : There’s no class today. Imani got the Dorm Wars labeled as a school-wide holiday so everybody can go home and watch the televised version.
lines.zh: : 今天没课。Imani 把宿舍大战申请成了全校假日，这样大家都能回家看电视转播版。

lines.en: : You mean to tell me this shit’s actually televised?
lines.zh: : 你是说这玩意儿还真上电视了？

lines.en: : Yeah. Crazy, right?
lines.zh: : 是啊。疯了吧？

lines.en: : We’ve sure come a long way in just a year.
lines.zh: : 才一年而已，我们可真是走了很远。

lines.en: : Aight, well...I guess just keep not fitting in or some shit until I get back. Like I said, won’t take long.
lines.zh: : 行吧，那……在我回来之前，你们就继续这么格格不入好了。我说过了，不会太久。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay! Good luck with whatever it is you’re doing!
lines.zh: : 好！祝你处理的事情顺利！

lines.en: : Yeah! And please hurry!
lines.zh: : 对！还有请快点！

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar38
: Oh, Yumi. What a surprise.
lines.zh: : 哦，Yumi。真意外。

lines.en: : Yeah, hi. I ain’t here to beat the shit out of anybody.
lines.zh: : 嗯，嗨。我不是来把谁揍个半死的。

lines.en: : That’s good.
lines.zh: : 那就好。

lines.en: : Do you want to hear who won the-
lines.zh: : 你想听听谁赢了——

lines.en: : Nah. Don’t care. Ain’t even really a part of the class anymore.
lines.zh: : 不。不关心。反正我也不算这个班的人了。

lines.en: : Just wanted to talk to the douchebag beside you for a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 就是想跟你旁边那个混蛋聊几分钟。

lines.en: : I’m assuming I am the douchebag?
lines.zh: : 我猜我就是那个混蛋？

lines.en: : Do you see anyone around here douchier than you?
lines.zh: : 这附近你看到有谁比你更混蛋吗？

lines.en: : Might I suggest the dolphin to my left?
lines.zh: : 我能不能推荐一下我左边那只海豚？

lines.en: : Fuck off.
lines.zh: : 滚蛋。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar39
: Jesus Christ, it speaks?!
lines.zh: : 天哪，它会说话？！

lines.en: : I ain’t talkin’ to a fuckin’ dolphin. Just come with me for a minute. It won’t take long.
lines.zh: : 我可不是来跟一只他妈的海豚说话的。跟我来一下。不会太久。

lines.en: : Imani...there’s not anything left for me to do, right?
lines.zh: : Imani……这边已经没我什么事了，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah there is. You’ve gotta protect me from the mystery dolphin. I didn’t realize it was {i}intelligent.{/i}
lines.zh: : 有的。你得保护我不被那只神秘海豚伤害。我还没意识到它居然{i}有智慧{/i}。

lines.en: : Ain’t got all day.
lines.zh: : 我没一整天的时间。

lines.en: : Sorry. Protect yourself.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你自己保护自己吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Senpai! Be careful! She’s a known assailant!
lines.zh: : 前辈！小心！她是有名的暴力分子！

lines.en: : I think I can take her.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我打得过她。

lines.en: : Yeah, you fucking wish.
lines.zh: : 哈，你他妈的想得美。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar40
: So...what’s going-
lines.zh: : 那么……什么事——

lines.en: : Listen...I'm just gonna cut right to the chase.
lines.zh: : 听着……我就直奔主题了。

lines.en: : Why’d you just let it happen?
lines.zh: : 你为什么就那么看着它发生了？

lines.en: : You know what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 你知道我在说什么。

lines.en: if nodokaspecial15p3 == False:
: It’s one thing to just sit there with your dick in your hands while a girl gets harrassed — a {i}shitty{/i} thing, I’ll add — but letting that happen to someone you {i}know?{/i}
lines.zh: : 一个女孩被骚扰的时候，你只是握着自己的鸡巴干坐着——这已经{i}够烂的{/i}了，我补充一句——可让这种事发生在你{i}认识{/i}的人身上？

lines.en: : Someone you’ve been actually pretty fuckin’ decent to recently?
lines.zh: : 一个你最近其实对她还挺他妈像样的人？

lines.en: : Was that all just for fun?
lines.zh: : 那些都只是为了好玩吗？

lines.en: : Did you ever actually want me to get better? Or was that all just some kind of sick game to you?
lines.zh: : 你到底有没有真的希望我好起来？还是说在你眼里那都只是某种变态游戏？

lines.en: else:
: I don’t have an excuse, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我没有借口，Yumi。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar41
: Yeah, how the fuck {i}could{/i} you?!
lines.zh: : 对啊，你他妈的怎么{i}可能{/i}有？！

lines.en: : What kind of shit do you think you can just say to make it feel like none of that ever happened?! Because if there’s some sorta miracle cure you think you can pull outta thin air, I’d love to hear it!
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能说出什么样的话，好让那一切都像从没发生过一样？！如果你以为能凭空掏出什么灵丹妙药，我倒是很想听听！

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: : Yumi——

lines.en: : I was finally starting to trust you! I thought you were on my side!
lines.zh: : 我终于开始信任你了！我以为你是站在我这边的！

lines.en: : All that shit with...helping me get a job! Helping me study! Genuinely fucking apologizing for the shitty things you’ve done to me! Was that all fake?! Some kind of plot to get me undressed?! To corner me?!
lines.zh: : 那一切都算什么……帮我找工作！帮我学习！真心他妈的为对我做过的烂事道歉！那些全是假的吗？！是某种想把我衣服扒光的阴谋？！想把我逼到死角？！

lines.en: : Is this just a game to you?! Am I a plaything?!
lines.zh: : 在你眼里这只是个游戏吗？！我只是个玩物吗？！

lines.en: : Nothing about that was or {i}is{/i} a game. I told you back then that I was just as surprised as you.
lines.zh: : 那一切过去不是、现在也{i}不是{/i}游戏。我当时就告诉过你，我和你一样吃惊。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar42
: Then why?...
lines.zh: : 那为什么？……

lines.en: : Why did you just freeze?
lines.zh: : 你为什么就那么僵住了？

lines.en: : You're a fucking {i}adult...{/i}
lines.zh: : 你是个他妈的{i}成年人啊……{/i}

lines.en: : Why didn’t you stand up to her?
lines.zh: : 你为什么没有站出来反抗她？

lines.en: : Because I didn’t know {i}how...{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为我不知道该{i}怎么{/i}做……

lines.en: : Or maybe some part of me didn’t want to.
lines.zh: : 又或者，我心里的某一部分并不想那么做。

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : I’m disgusting, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我很恶心，Yumi。

lines.en: : You know it. I know it. Everyone knows it. It’s not like I try to keep it a secret.
lines.zh: : 你知道。我知道。所有人都知道。我也没打算瞒着。

lines.en: : And I’m not just talking about forcing myself on you either. I’m talking about {i}everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而且我说的还不只是强迫你那件事。我说的是{i}一切{/i}。

lines.en: : Do you have {i}any{/i} idea how many times I’ve gotten off while thinking about you? Because the number would make you sick.
lines.zh: : 你{i}知道{/i}我曾经想着你射过多少次吗？那个数字会让你恶心。

lines.en: : Why...are you telling me this? That’s not why I-
lines.zh: : 你为什么……要告诉我这些？我又不是因为这个才——

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar43
: Because lying to you doesn’t work. And I’m sure you don’t {i}want{/i} me to lie to you either.
lines.zh: : 因为对你撒谎没用。而且我确信你也{i}不想{/i}让我对你撒谎。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}know{/i} why I froze. But I did. And I can’t go back in time and change that, just like I can’t go back in time and change when I kissed you.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}知道{/i}我为什么会僵住。但我确实僵住了。我没法回到过去改变它，就像我没法回到过去改变我吻你那件事。

lines.en: : Or, I don’t know. Maybe I can. But I don’t {i}want{/i} to because it’s those things that brought us here.
lines.zh: : 或者，我不知道。也许我能。但我{i}不想{/i}，因为正是那些事把我们带到了这里。

lines.en: : And even if this world is fucked beyond belief and I’m going to repeatedly destroy any hope you’ll ever have in me, I can’t change.
lines.zh: : 而且就算这个世界烂得不可思议，就算我会一次次摧毁你对我抱有的任何希望，我也改变不了。

lines.en: : I {i}won’t{/i} change.
lines.zh: : 我{i}不会{/i}改变。

lines.en: : But {i}you{/i} will.
lines.zh: : 但{i}你{/i}会。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar44
: If you want to keep staying away from me, that’s fine. I don’t blame you.
lines.zh: : 如果你想继续躲着我，没关系。我不怪你。

lines.en: : You’ve already given me multiple chances to redeem myself and I’ve squandered every single one of them.
lines.zh: : 你已经给过我好几次机会让我赎罪，而我每一次都糟蹋了。

lines.en: : You can’t trust me.
lines.zh: : 你不能信任我。

lines.en: : You were an idiot for ever {i}thinking{/i} you could trust me after all I’ve done to you.
lines.zh: : 在对你做了那么多事之后，你居然还{i}以为{/i}能信任我，那真是傻。

lines.en: : And the most disheartening part of all of that is I can’t even remember some of it.
lines.zh: : 而这一切中最让人心灰意冷的是，有些事我甚至记不起来了。

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar45
: Or maybe I can...but I {i}don't.{/i}
lines.zh: : 又或者我记得……但我选择{i}不{/i}。

lines.en: : Maybe I just {i}choose{/i} not to remember because of the way it makes me feel.
lines.zh: : 也许我只是因为那种感觉太难受，所以{i}选择{/i}不去记起。

lines.en: : But I’d do it all again in a heartbeat because that’s just who I am.
lines.zh: : 但如果有下次，我会在一瞬间里再做一遍，因为我就是这样的人。

lines.en: : Never count on me.
lines.zh: : 永远别指望我。

lines.en: : Never believe in me.
lines.zh: : 永远别相信我。

lines.en: : {s}And run away while you still can.{/s}
lines.zh: : {s}趁你还跑得掉，赶紧逃吧。{/s}

lines.en: : But why?...
lines.zh: : 可是为什么？……

lines.en: : Why what?
lines.zh: : 为什么什么？

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar46
: Why are you telling me this {i}now?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 你为什么{i}现在{/i}才跟我说这些？……

lines.en: : Uhh...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 呃……老师？

lines.en: scene endofsecondwar47
: I think we’ve got a bit of a problem...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们有点麻烦了……
